# Index

The root of the vault. Everything the resolver has to get right is linked
from here.

- Relative, a directory down: [the nested note](nested/note.md)
- Relative with a fragment: [its heading](nested/note.md#a-heading)
- A wikilink resolved beside this file: [[note]]
- The same one, aliased: [[note|the note]]
- And with a fragment: [[note#A Heading]]
- A target that is not there: [[missing]]
- A target that is there twice: [[dup]]
- Percent-encoded, as an editor writes it: [a spaced note](spaced%20note.md)
- Somewhere else entirely: [the web](https://example.com)
- A fragment on this page: [back to the top](#index)
